d:
Noida is known for its IT hubs, metro connectivity and high-rise buildings. But in Hindon Pushta, residents are still struggling with basic facilities like electricity, roads and drainage.
In this ground report, Nilanjan Tiwari explores the ground reality of Noida’s urban development and how the lack of electricity is affecting everyday life and local businesses, including the sale of milk, curd and paneer.
Reporter: Nilanjan Tiwari
Camera & Editor: Pankaj
